name: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus
summary: At Light's Hope Chapel, Lord Maxwell Tyrosus directs the Argent Dawn's defense against the Scourge. A veteran paladin of the Silver Hand, he also sends forces against blighted strongholds such as Stratholme.

sections.title: A Veteran of Lordaeron
sections.body: In the Third War, Maxwell Tyrosus rode with Uther the Lightbringer. He guarded Andorhal's exits as the Scourge tore through the kingdom. After Lordaeron fell, Tyrosus joined the Argent Dawn. The order welcomes anyone willing to fight the Scourge, unlike the Scarlet Crusade and its human-only zealotry.

sections.title: Commander of the Dawn
sections.body: Tyrosus leads the Argent Dawn and directs the defenses of Light's Hope Chapel. From his command post inside the chapel, he oversees military operations across the Plaguelands. Among them are tactical assaults led by Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff against Baron Rivendare in the ruins of Stratholme.

faq.answer: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus is a veteran human paladin who leads the Argent Dawn. He fought under Uther the Lightbringer during the Third War. Now he commands Light's Hope Chapel's defense and the order's campaign to cleanse the Plaguelands.

faq.q: Why did Tyrosus leave the Scarlet Crusade?
aliases: why did tyrosus leave scarlet crusade
faq.answer: No record places Tyrosus among the Scarlet Crusade. He leads the Argent Dawn, an order that welcomes any race willing to fight the Scourge, unlike the Crusade's human-only zealotry.

faq.q: Where can Maxwell Tyrosus be found?
faq.answer: You can find Maxwell Tyrosus inside the sanctuary of Light's Hope Chapel, the Argent Dawn's fortified stronghold in the far eastern reaches of the Eastern Plaguelands.

faq.q: What is Tyrosus's role in the war against Stratholme?
faq.answer: Tyrosus coordinates military strategy with Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff. He sends proven adventurers and strike teams to breach Stratholme and eliminate Baron Rivendare, the Lich King's commander in the region.

faq.q: Does Tyrosus allow anyone to meet with him?
faq.answer: Tyrosus rarely grants audiences to outsiders. He has spent years secluded in war councils, directing the frontline effort. Adventurers usually need to earn the Argent Dawn's deep respect or bring critical intelligence to gain his attention.

angles.text: As a paladin, you can see Tyrosus uphold the Silver Hand's spirit through compassion, unity, and discipline after Uther's death and the tragic corruption of the order's splinter factions.
Though born a nobleman of Lordaeron and a hero of the Alliance, Tyrosus now commits his forces to an independent order that welcomes anyone willing to fight the Scourge.
Unlike the zealots in Hearthglen and the Scarlet Monastery, Tyrosus champions cooperation with non-humans. Horde warriors and shamans are accepted as equals within Light's Hope Chapel.
